types.name: AccountFrozenEvent
docs: Event emitted when a token account is frozen

types.name: AccountThawedEvent
docs: Event emitted when a token account is thawed

types.name: AuthorityType
docs: Authority type enum for authority update events

types.name: AuthorityUpdateCancelled
docs: Event emitted when a pending authority update is cancelled

types.name: AuthorityUpdatePending
docs: Event emitted when a pending authority is set (step 1 of authority transfer)

types.name: AuthorityUpdated
docs: Event emitted when an authority transfer is finalized (step 2 of authority transfer)

types.name: ExternalTreasuryUpdated
docs: Event emitted when external treasury is updated

types.name: MaxRemovalPercentageUpdated
docs: Event emitted when the maximum removal percentage is updated

types.name: MinimumStakeAmountUpdated
docs: Event emitted when the minimum stake amount is updated

types.name: MinimumUnstakeAmountUpdated
docs: Event emitted when the minimum unstake amount is updated

types.name: MintAuthorityTransferCancelled
docs: Event emitted when mint authority transfer is cancelled

types.name: MintAuthorityTransferPending
docs: Event emitted when a pending mint authority is set (step 1 of mint authority transfer)

types.name: MintAuthorityTransferred
docs: Event emitted when mint authority is transferred (step 2: finalized)

fields.name: vault_balance
docs: Vault balance at the time of ownership transfer

types.name: ProgramInitialized
docs: Event emitted when the program is initialized

types.name: ProgramState
docs: State account for the liquid staking program

fields.name: version
docs: Version for future compatibility

fields.name: authority
docs: Authority that can add yield and update configuration

fields.name: pending_authority
docs: Pending authority waiting for acceptance (set by current authority)

fields.name: pending_authority_expiration_timestamp
docs: Timestamp when pending_authority expires (must be finalized before this time)

fields.name: operations_authority
docs: Operations authority for managing specific operations

fields.name: compliance_authority
docs: Compliance authority for compliance-related operations

fields.name: underlying_token_mint
docs: Mint address of the underlying token

fields.name: liquid_staking_token_mint
docs: Mint address of the liquid staking token

fields.name: state_bump
docs: Bump seed for the state account PDA

fields.name: is_staking_enabled
docs: Boolean indicating if staking is enabled

fields.name: is_unstaking_request_enabled
docs: Boolean indicating if requesting unstaking is enabled

fields.name: is_unstaking_claim_enabled
docs: Boolean indicating if claiming unstaking is enabled

fields.name: minimum_stake_amount
docs: Minimum amount that can be staked

fields.name: minimum_unstake_amount
docs: Minimum amount that can be unstaked

fields.name: max_removal_percentage
docs: Maximum percentage of vault balance that can be removed per remove_yield call (in basis points, default: 500 = 5%)

fields.name: external_treasury_token_account
docs: External treasury address for underlying tokens (can be set by authority)

fields.name: treasury_cooldown_end_timestamp
docs: Timestamp when the treasury update cooldown ends (allows yield removal after this time)

fields.name: remove_yield_cooldown_end_timestamp
docs: Timestamp when the remove yield cooldown ends (allows next yield removal after this time)

fields.name: withdrawal_delay_seconds
docs: Unstake delay for unstaking (default: 604800 = 7 days)

fields.name: pending_mint_authority
docs: Pending mint authority waiting for acceptance (set by current authority)

fields.name: pending_mint_authority_expiration_timestamp
docs: Timestamp when pending_mint_authority expires (must be finalized before this time)

types.name: StakingEnabled
docs: Event emitted when staking is toggled

types.name: TokenMetadataUpdated
docs: Event emitted when token metadata is created or updated

types.name: UnderlyingRestaked
docs: Event emitted when an unstake request is restaked

types.name: UnderlyingStaked
docs: Event emitted whenever underlying tokens are staked for liquid staking tokens

types.name: UnstakeClaimed
docs: Event emitted when an unstake is claimed

types.name: UnstakeRequested
docs: Event emitted when an unstake is requested

types.name: UnstakingClaimEnabled
docs: Event emitted when unstaking claim is toggled

types.name: UnstakingRequestEnabled
docs: Event emitted when unstaking request is toggled

types.name: UserUnstakeRequest
docs: Per-user account to track unstake requests

fields.name: version
docs: Version for future compatibility

fields.name: request_timestamp
docs: Timestamp when the request was created

fields.name: withdrawal_delay_end_timestamp
docs: Timestamp when the withdrawal delay ends (request_timestamp + unstake_cooldown_seconds)

fields.name: bump
docs: Bump seed for the user unstake request account PDA

types.name: WithdrawalDelayUpdated
docs: Event emitted when the withdrawal delay is updated

types.name: YieldRemoved
docs: Event emitted when yield is removed to external treasury
